facts.fact: The Information Regulator enforced the Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 against Central Johannesburg TVET College.
facts.system: Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013

facts.fact: The Information Regulator, with a named chairperson and members, issued POPIA enforcement notices.
An enforcement notice dated 22 May 2026 found Central Johannesburg TVET College had contravened POPIA and directed corrective actions.
